start: Signed in as the owner; member page of a member with a full mobile number and money due; internet on

steps.action: Tap "WhatsApp" next to the phone number
user_sees: Sheet titled "WhatsApp <member name>"
Chips under "Which message"
A language picker
Box "Message (you can change it)" already filled
Green button "Send on WhatsApp"
must_not: A message about another member
A wrong amount or a wrong last day in the ready text

steps.action: Change a word in the message
user_sees: The changed text stays in the box
must_not: The text jumping back while typing

steps.action: Tap "Send on WhatsApp" (the test stops here: never press send inside WhatsApp)
user_sees: WhatsApp opens in a new tab on this member's number with the message typed, waiting for the person to press send
must_not: A message sent with no press inside WhatsApp
Another person's number
The message cut short or with broken letters

start: Signed in as the owner; WhatsApp sheet open for a member whose plan has ended and whose birthday is today

steps.action: Tap another chip under "Which message" (plan ended, birthday)
user_sees: The box is filled again with that message
must_not: A "Haven’t seen you" chip for a member who trains fine
A birthday chip on a day that is not the birthday

steps.action: Change the language in the picker
user_sees: The same message in the picked language
The pick is remembered the next time the sheet opens
must_not: Two languages mixed in one message
The amount or the day changed by the language

start: Signed in as the owner; member page of a member whose mobile number is not complete

steps.action: Tap "WhatsApp"
user_sees: Red box "This mobile number is not complete, so WhatsApp can’t open it. Tap Edit on their page to fix it."
No "Send on WhatsApp" button
must_not: WhatsApp opening on a wrong or half number

steps.action: Turn the internet off and look at the member page
user_sees: The link reads "WhatsApp (needs internet)", greyed, and does nothing
must_not: The sheet opening and failing only at the last step

start: Signed in as the owner; WhatsApp sheet open, message changed by hand

steps.action: Close the sheet, open it again
user_sees: The ready message again (the hand change is not kept)
must_not: Yesterday's changed text sent to today's member

steps.action: Tap "Send on WhatsApp", come back to the panel
user_sees: The sheet as it was; nothing on the member page says a message was sent
must_not: The member marked as reminded when nothing was sent
A second WhatsApp tab opening by itself

start: Signed in as the owner; member page of a member who owes money

steps.action: Open the WhatsApp sheet on the fees message and read the text
user_sees: Only this member's name, plan, day and amount, and the gym's name
must_not: Another member's dues or name in the text
The message going to any number but this member's own
The message text saved anywhere after the sheet closes
